mapper.sql: p.id AS post_id, m.id AS member_id, m.name AS member_name, m.unique_id AS unique_id, m.profile_image AS profile_image_url, p.content AS content, pi.image_url AS main_image_url, p.like_count AS like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reply r WHERE r.post_id = p.id ) AS comment_count, FALSE AS liked_by_me, p.subscriber_only AS subscriber_only, p.created_at AS created_at, p.updated_at AS updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.member_id JOIN post_image pi ON pi.post_id = p.id AND pi.image_order = 1
AND p.subscriber_only = FALSE
AND ( p.like_count < #{cursorLikeCount} OR (p.like_count = #{cursorLikeCount} AND p.id < #{cursorPostId}) )
ORDER BY p.like_count DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
